results.name: MichiganCountyBoundary
results.title: Michigan County Boundaries
results.description:
This feature layer contains county boundaries derived from the U.S. Census Bureau’s Redistricting Census 2000 TIGER/Line files.

The layer uses county boundaries based on January 1, 2000 legal geography. Great Lakes open-water areas are excluded, so county polygons terminate at the approximate shoreline rather than extending into the lakes.
results.licenseInfo: Public domain source data. This layer was derived from U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line® Shapefiles, which are works of the U.S. Government and are not subject to domestic copyright protection under 17 U.S.C. § 105. The Great Lakes Commission dissolved the source congressional district polygons by state to create this regional state-boundary layer. Please acknowledge the U.S. Census Bureau as the source of the underlying geographic data.

results.title: Lake County Boundary
results.description:
Download In State Plane Projection Here. 

This is our working version of the Lake County boundary. Although technically the county's eastern border extends eastward into Lake Michigan to the state line where Illinois meets Michigan, we routinely use the Lake Michigan shoreline as our eastern boundary for mapping purposes. The north, west and south boundaries are based on a compilation of survey data which aligns well, but not perfectly, with the border as mapped by neighboring counties and the State of Wisconsin, which forms the northern boundary of the county.


Update Frequency:
This dataset is updated on a weekly basis.

results.title: Illinois Counties
results.description: County boundaries of Illinois.  This feature class was derived from the Navteq (HERE) county boundaries layer provided with the Navteq (HERE) data delivery.  Illinois counties were selected out and saved as a new feature class.  The borders of Lake and Cook Counties were modified to reflect the Lake Michigan shoreline rather than the true administrative boundary which extends to the middle of the lake.  The shoreline was drawn from the 2005 set of digital ortho quad photography. Data layer created 2007. The fields names were changed in April 2018.
results.snippet: County boundaries of Illinois. This feature class was derived from the Navteq (HERE) county boundaries layer provided with the Navteq (HERE) data delivery.
